name: tabworks
description: TabWorks Bridge CLI，管理本地浏览器桥接服务、日志面板和可复用自动化 routine

scripts.build: bun run viewer:build && bun run extension:build
scripts.extension:build: rm -rf extension/dist && mkdir -p extension/dist && cp extension/manifest.json extension/popup.html extension/guide.html extension/dist/ && cp -R extension/icons extension/images extension/dist/ && bun build extension/src/background.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=extension/dist/background.js && bun build extension/src/popup.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/popup.js && bun build extension/src/guide.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/guide.js && bun build extension/src/recorder-content.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/recorder-content.js && bun build extension/src/recorder-main.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/recorder-main.js && bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i extension/src/popup.css -o extension/dist/popup.css --minify && bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i extension/src/guide.css -o extension/dist/guide.css --minify
